matches.rationale: GT-1 concerns the unjustified elimination of the tensor product operator in Section 3.1 when deriving the concise JMMD via the Representer theorem. None of the findings address this specific methodological gap: pred_1 concerns an undefined matrix M^H in Section 3.3; pred_2 concerns notation for the label kernel in Theorem 1; pred_3 concerns missing verification of the Laplacian property in Section 3.4. All three findings point to different loci and different defects than the tensor product elimination issue in Section 3.1.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Reports an undefined matrix M^H not covered in ground truth, but appears to be a legitimate observation about the paper.
Reports a notational inconsistency for the label kernel not covered in ground truth, but appears to be a valid observation.
Reports missing verification of Laplacian property in Section 3.4, not covered in ground truth, but appears to be a legitimate methodological concern.
